registry.description: Prayer is the act of addressing God directly — speaking and listening within the relationship between the creature and the Creator. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary covers petition, supplication, intercession, praise, and the casting of one's cares. Prayer is the breath of the inner life in relationship with God: it is how trust is exercised, how need is expressed, how grief is given language, and how the person remains in living contact with the One who made them. It assumes that God hears, that he is personal, and that the relationship is real.
